_about: Smoke-test cases for epitopes-by-source. Each case lists a source input and key facts the run should produce, validating source resolution (alias / NCBITaxon id / ambiguity), the NCBITaxon subtree rollup, the breakdown invariants, post-filters, and output artifacts against the live IEDB IQ-API epitope_search endpoint.

expect.invariant: breakdowns.linear + breakdowns.discontinuous == breakdowns.total; sum(mhc_class_dist counts) == total; with_positive <= total
strains_include: Human herpesvirus 4 strain B95-8 (Epstein-Barr virus (strain B95-8))

expect.note: Bare NCBITaxon id resolves to the same set as the EBV alias.

expect.error_contains: No source organism in IEDB matching
expect.note: Lists the alias options and the NCBITaxon-id hint.

expect.invariant: n_after_filters <= n_fetched; every epitope has any_positive == true AND 'I' in mhc_classes AND linear_bucket == 'linear'.

how_to_run: From the skill directory: python scripts/epitopes_by_source.py EBV -o /tmp/ebv_eval && python3 -c "import json;d=json.load(open('/tmp/ebv_eval/epitopes_NCBITaxon_10376.json'));m=d['metadata'];b=d['breakdowns'];seqs={e['linear_sequence'] for e in d['epitopes']};print('iri',m['source']['iri'],m['source']['resolution']);print('total',b['total'],'linear+disc',b['linear']+b['discontinuous']);print('GLCTLVAML',('GLCTLVAML' in seqs),'RAKFKQLL',('RAKFKQLL' in seqs))"
